name: Technology
description: Technology sector includes companies involved in computing, software, hardware, semiconductors, and IT services.

name: Healthcare
description: Healthcare sector encompasses pharmaceuticals, medical devices, biotech, and healthcare services companies.

name: Financial
description: Financial sector includes banks, insurance companies, investment firms, and other financial services.

name: Consumer Staples
description: Consumer Staples includes companies producing essential consumer goods like food, beverages, and household products.

name: Consumer Cyclical
description: Consumer Cyclical sector includes retailers, restaurants, and discretionary consumer goods companies.

name: Industrial
description: Industrial sector comprises manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and machinery companies.

name: Energy
description: Energy sector includes oil and gas companies, as well as energy production and exploration firms.

name: Utilities
description: Utilities sector includes electric, gas, and water distribution companies providing essential services.

name: Communication
description: Communication sector includes telecommunications, media, and entertainment companies.
